column1: # sdk/class-names.tsv — every Java class the runtime may name from Rust:
# the SDK's own classes, the java/** and javax/** names pico-jvm serves,
# after adding, removing or renaming an SDK class or a builtin.
# build_support/names.rs turns each row into a `c::<ident>` const (value =
# the active shrink map's target under --shrink, the original otherwise)
# that Rust names the class through; never spell one as a literal.
